children: BlossomHill Therapeutics, Inc. reported a net loss of $(23.8)M for the three months ended June 30, 2026, compared with a $(13.2)M loss in the year-ago quarter; diluted loss per share was $(8.75) versus $(5.51) in the prior-year quarter. The company reported no product revenue for the periods presented as it continues to operate as a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company.
Net income: $(23.8)M net loss for the three months ended June 30, 2026, versus $(13.2)M in the year-ago quarter (≈ $(10.5)M wider YoY).
Diluted EPS: $(8.75) for the three months ended June 30, 2026, versus $(5.51) in the year-ago quarter.
Revenue: Not reported for the periods presented (company has no product sales; all periods show net loss).
Clinical progress: SOLARA Phase 1/2 is enrolling for BH-30643 with confirmed responses, including in the C797S cohort; chemotherapy combination cohorts are planned.
Pipeline expansion: BH-30236 Phase 1 dose escalation is ongoing in relapsed/refractory AML and high-risk MDS, with exploration of venetoclax combinations and additional myeloid indications.
Preclinical advancement: IND-enabling work for BH-501284 is underway with an IND planned in Q1 2027 for a pan‑KRAS candidate.
Operational build-out: R&D headcount has increased and the company is expanding clinical sites and manufacturing to support multiple clinical programs.
Liquidity runway & plans: IPO proceeds plus cash are expected to fund operations into Q2 2028, enabling a pivotal Phase 2 start for BH-30643 in 2027.
